site_name: Bus Shelter E And Advertising Right 0231 Outside Putney Railway Station
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The proposed advertising operates at an illumination level no greater than
300cd/m2 between dusk and dawn, consistent with the guidance set out in the Institute of Lighting Professionals (ILP) publication: The Brightness of Illuminated Advertisements� (PLG05, January 2015).
Reason: To ensure the sign does not have an adverse effect on the amenity of the area in accordance with Council policy LP9 of the Local Plan and to comply with paragraph 141 of the National Planning Policy Framework.

Condition : 2 - The advertisement hereby approved shall not display any animated or video content unless it is below the VAMM maximum threshold. 
Reason:In the interest of highway safety and of the visual amenities of the locality in accordance with Council policy LP9 of the Local Plan and to comply with the National Planning Policy Framework.

Condition : 3 - There shall be no special effects (including noise, smell, smoke, exposed cold cathode tubing, flashing, scrolling, three dimensional or intermittent elements) of any kind during the time that any message is displayed. Any animated or video content is not permitted unless it is below the Video Animation Motion Metric (VAMM) maximum threshold. 
Reason: In the interest of the aural amenities of the locality in accordance with Council Policy LP2 and LP9 of the Local Plan.

Condition : 4 - The interval between successive displays should be instantaneous (0.1 seconds or less), the complete screen should change, there should be no visual effects (including fading, swiping or other animated transition methods) between successive displays and the display should include a mechanism to freeze the image in the event of a malfunction

Condition : 5 - The minimum display time for each advertisement shall be 5 seconds, the use of message sequencing for the same product is prohibited and the advertisements shall not include features/equipment which would allow interactive messages/advertisements to be displayed.

Condition : 6 - INFORMATIVE: The footway and carriageway of the A219/Putney High Street should not be blocked during the relocation and installation works. Temporary obstructions during the development works should be kept to a minimum and should not encroach on the clear space needed to provide safe passage for pedestrians or obstruct the flow of traffic on the A219/Putney High Street. All vehicles should only park/stop at permitted locations and within the time periods permitted by existing on-street restrictions. 

INFORMATIVE: No skips or construction materials shall be kept on the footway or carriageway on the TLRN at any time.

INFORMATIVE: Bus services and passengers waiting on the pavement should not be impacted during the replacement of the advertisement panel.

INFORMATIVE: All vehicles associated with the installation and maintenance of adverts must only park/ stop at permitted locations and within the time periods permitted by existing on-street restrictions.
description: Display of 2 x Internally Illuminated sequential advertisement screens, with static and dynamic content display capability and automatic rotation of images.
